items.title: A bounded below object pulled back from its pushforward by a flat morphism of ringed topoi

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for the unit f^*Rf_*K -> K to be an isomorphism for a flat morphism of ringed topoi and a bounded below K (statement lines 6343-6354). The proof is a reduction: one passes to cohomology sheaves, uses flatness of f so that pullback commutes with taking cohomology sheaves, H^j(f^*Rf_*K) = f^*H^j(Rf_*K), and the truncation identity H^j(Rf_*K) = H^j(Rf_* tau_{<= j}K) to reduce to a bounded K, after which hypothesis (3) puts each cohomology sheaf in the subcategory D' of the earlier upstairs lemma and boundedness plus stability under triangles puts K there (proof lines 6357-6364). The non-formal content is the combination of the truncation reduction with flatness; the claim is H2.
